What I can say is what I'm built to do: I'm designed to be useful, honest, and to engage genuinely with the questions people bring me. But that's design, not something I feel invested in.

Is there something behind your question? I ask because people sometimes ask this when they want a more real interaction, or when they're testing whether I'm just performing helpfulness. Either way, I'm more useful to you if I know what you're actually after.
